findings.category: explicit run port override blocked by SERVER_NAME port parsing

evidence_refs.description: The configured SERVER_NAME port is parsed unconditionally.
An explicit run port takes precedence, but this branch is reached only after SERVER_NAME parsing.
The base revision split SERVER_NAME as text and skipped converting its port when an explicit port was supplied.

findings.technical_rationale: For SERVER_NAME='localhost:65536', accessing urlsplit(...).port raises ValueError before app.run(port=8000) can apply the explicit override. The base revision could run with that override because it did not parse the configured port in this case.
findings.comment_usefulness_rationale: A focused comment can ask that configured-port validation occur only when that port is used, preserving the documented explicit port override.

review_summary: Reviewed the frozen diff and bounded surrounding implementation and tests. Found one low-severity regression in app.run port override handling.
